title: Stat Cards
content: Build stat/metric display cards. Structure: main value, label, optional change indicator. Number formatting: large numbers abbreviated (1.2M), currency, percentages. Change indicator: up/down arrow with positive (green) or negative (red) styling. Comparison: "vs last period" or percentage change. Icon: category icon for visual context. Mini chart: optional sparkline trend. Grid layout: responsive grid of stat cards. Loading: skeleton state while fetching. Click action: optionally navigate to detailed view. Emphasis: larger size for primary metrics.

variants.simple: Display key metrics in formatted stat cards.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive stat/metric display cards for dashboards. Card structure: icon (optional, top-left), main value (large, prominent), label/title (smaller, descriptive), change indicator (with comparison context). Value formatting: use Intl.NumberFormat, abbreviate thousands/millions (formatCompact), currency symbols, percentage formatting, decimal precision based on value size. Change indicator: calculate percentage change from previous period, TrendingUp (green-600) for positive, TrendingDown (red-600) for negative, Minus (gray-400) for no change, display as "+12.5%" or "-8.3%". Comparison context: "vs last week", "vs previous month", "YoY" - smaller text below change. Icon: optional category icon (DollarSign for revenue, Users for user count, etc.) with colored background circle. Trend visualization: optional small sparkline (tiny line chart) showing recent trend, or bar chart for comparison. Layout: grid of cards, responsive (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Size variants: compact (single line), standard, large (hero metric). Loading state: skeleton matching card layout with pulse animation. Interactivity: hover effect if clickable, click navigates to detailed report. Comparison modes: absolute change, percentage change, vs target. Tooltip: additional context on hover (exact values, date range). Color themes: neutral for standard, colored for specific metrics (revenue gold, users blue, etc.).
